description: This file defines the InvestLocation class within the Goteo project, which manages investment location data and access permissions related to investments.

classes.name: InvestLocation
classes.description: Represents the location associated with an investment, including permission checks for viewing and editing based on user roles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the InvestLocation object and links it to the related investment.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an InvestLocation record by investment ID or object.

methods.name: userCanView
methods.description: Determines if a given user has permission to view this investment location, based on ownership or impersonation rights.

methods.name: userCanEdit
methods.description: Checks if a user can edit the investment location, same criteria as view permission.
